title: Advertise the IRCv3 capabilities mimid can honour
description:
The capabilities mimid does not advertise, which is where a verb becomes reachable. A client sends what CAP LS offered and nothing else, so the verbs of bead mimid-1wgh.140.5 are unreachable without this, and several client behaviours mimid already supports go unused.

ADVERTISED TODAY (crates/mimid-agent-irc/src/register.rs): batch, draft/chathistory, draft/event-playback, draft/message-redaction, draft/read-marker, echo-message, message-tags, multi-prefix, sasl, server-time, soju.im/account-required, soju.im/webpush.

WORTH ADDING, each specified in ~/PROJECT/IETF/specs as ircv3-<name>.md:

- away-notify: tells a client when a user's away state changes. mimid already answers AWAY, so the state exists and nothing propagates it.
- extended-join, account-notify, account-tag: carry the account a nick belongs to. A nick is not an identity here and the user URI is the thing that matters, so these are the standard way to show a client which MIMI user a nick is, rather than hoping the nick is enough. This is the same problem WHOWAS addresses after the fact (bead mimid-1wgh.140.3).
- invite-notify: makes an invite visible to a channel's members rather than only to the invited user.
- labeled-response: pairs a reply with the command that caused it. Worth more here than on a network, because a mimid reply can be slow: a sync or a Commit stands between the command and its answer, which is the whole subject of bead mimid-604m.
- utf8only: mimid is UTF-8 throughout and its casemapping is its own; advertising it states a fact rather than adding behaviour.
- standard-replies: the front end already sends FAIL, so this is advertising what it does.
- chghost: marginal, listed for completeness, since a mimid nick's host does not change.

FOR EACH ONE: read its spec file before writing anything, implement what it requires rather than the name, and add it to CAP LS and to docs/design/agent-frontends.md with the file it came from. A capability advertised and not honoured is worse than one absent, because a client then changes its behaviour on a promise.

NOT A CAPABILITY LIST FOR ITS OWN SAKE: anything here that mimid cannot honour completely stays unadvertised, and the bead's close reason says which were left out and why.
